decisions.reason: The firm has invested visibly in the DPA management tool, giving it its own page and customer praise for agency templates, and it is central to the announced compliance direction, so dropping it would write off that commitment.
The management platform is featured on the home page and embodies the agency-focused platform strategy, so it carries the heaviest public commitment and investment and is very unlikely to be dropped.

The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business, has had its own page for two years, and fits the scalable hosting promise, so abandoning it would expose an earlier decision with little gain.

Extended PHP security support has only been mentioned on the website and has the least invested in it, but it supports the security and compliance promise, and weak results can still be attributed to its recent launch, so it is likely kept for now.
